Written July 2, 2026
Restaurant F
Hello,

As the owner of the restaurant, I would like to clarify a few points.

Your claim that we respect foreign guests more than Vietnamese guests is completely untrue.

You ordered three main courses without requesting a serving order, so our staff followed the normal kitchen workflow. When you later said the mussels should have been served first because they were a “dessert,” our staff simply explained that “dessert” means a “tráng miệng”. It was a factual explanation, not dis respect, but unfortunately it appears to have been misunderstood. We acknowledge that we could have asked your preferred serving order, and I personally apologized and suggested to re-serve the remaining dishes later. You declined our proposed solution.

What concerned us most was not the complaint itself, but the one-sided manner in which the conversation was conducted. We listened, apologized, and offered a solution, yet our explanation was not given the same consideration.

Regarding payment, our no vn-credit-card policy is clearly stated on the menu. Confirming bank transfers before guests leave is our standard procedure for everyone. Your VAT invoice has been issued as a walk-in invoice and is available upon request.

Finally, you recorded me without consent, while the entire interaction was also captured by our cameras. We trust that any recordings will be used responsibly and in accordance with the law. The restaurant reserves the right to protect its staff and reputation against any false or misleading claims.

We appreciate honest feedback, but we also believe reviews should reflect the full context of what actually happened.

French dining done right & I’m still thinking about that steak!
Apr 2026 • Couples
Yessss!

As Vietnam has French influence, there are quite a few French restaurants in Hanoi and we chose this one. It’s a little outside the Old Town, so we grabbed a taxi, but totally worth it.

The food was incredible, beautifully presented and full of flavour. I had the fillet steak with a creamy mustard sauce and potatoes and I’m literally drooling writing this, it was that good.

We also got a bottle of red, and the whole experience just felt a bit more elevated. 

Service was 10/10.

Would absolutely recommend.

Disappointing
May 2025 • Friends
The food was disappointing and so was the service. The reviews rave but the lamb was not baked and the wine was not served out of the bottles. The onion soup was weak and not very hot. Overall, mediocre food, and not very good service.
Written May 6, 2025
Restaurant F
Dear sir,
Thank you for taking time to share your feedback. We're sorry to hear that your experience did not meet expectations. We'd like to clarify that our lamb dish is traditional stewed, as described on the menu, not baked. Additionally, as a casual bistro, we serve wine by the glass rather than presenting bottles, which is more common in fine dining establishments. But if you asked the waitress, she'd loved to do in front of you.

We understand these details may have led to some disappointment, and we truly regret that the onion soup was not served at the proper temperature—this is something we will address with our kitchen team immediately.
